user.title: Connect to SmartHome Core
user.description: Enter the Core connection and any enhanced timer output mappings. SmartHome Core handles conversation and execution; Home Assistant owns voice activation and speech output.

persona.title: Choose a persona
persona.description: Select the persona this SmartHome Assistant agent will use. Home Assistant continues to own wake word and speech output.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure SmartHome Core
reconfigure.description: Update the Core connection and enhanced timer output mappings.

reconfigure_persona.title: Choose a persona
reconfigure_persona.description: Select the persona this SmartHome Assistant agent will use. Home Assistant continues to own wake word and speech output.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Core. Check its URL and availability.
error.unsupported_protocol: Core does not support protocol version 1.
error.invalid_persona: Choose a persona offered by Core or keep the saved persona.
error.invalid_timer_outputs: Map assist_satellite entities to unique esphome actions ending in _smarthome_timer_exchange_v1. Finish or cancel active timers before changing their timer output mapping.

init.title: Persona and timer outputs
init.description: Home Assistant owns wake word and speech output. Enhanced timer mappings select compatible acknowledged EchoMuse exchange actions.
